You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words. Use all the notes in your email to Sandy.

a:
Hi Sandy,

Thanks for your email. I'm really looking forward to the visit too!

I think I'd prefer to relax at home on the first evening, because I'll be tired after the long journey. We could watch a film and have a pizza. Perhaps we can go to a concert another time.

I'm not sure about climbing in the mountains. I'm afraid of heights, so I'd rather not, but we could go for a walk by the lake instead.

Could you tell me what kind of clothes I should bring?

See you soon,
Anna

parts.inst: Choose one of these questions (Question 2 or Question 3). Write your answer in about 100 words.

a:
Films: cinema or home?

I love films, especially comedies and science fiction. Most of the time I prefer watching them at the cinema. The screen is huge, the sound is fantastic and I can forget about everything else for two hours. Also, going with friends and sharing popcorn is great fun.

However, watching at home is cheaper and more comfortable. I can choose any film I like, stop it when I want to make a snack and wear my pyjamas! So I go to the cinema for big new films and stay at home for the rest.

As the plane flew lower, Lou saw the golden beaches of the island below. She felt excited and a little nervous. This was her first holiday alone.

When she got off the plane, a man was holding a sign with her name on it. 'Welcome, Lou,' he said. 'Your boat is waiting.' Lou was surprised because she had not booked a boat.

They sailed to a small hotel hidden between the trees. Inside, her old friend Mark was waiting with a big smile. 'Happy birthday!' he said. It was a surprise party his family had planned for months. Lou laughed and cried at the same time. It was the best birthday of her life.

speaking: Cards
Part 1 · Interview
The examiner asks each candidate about their life. Answer with full sentences and add a reason or an example.
What's your name? Where do you live?
Do you work or are you a student? What do you do/study?
How do you get to work/school/university every day?
What did you do yesterday evening/last weekend?
Do you think that English will be useful for you in the future? Why/Why not?
Tell us about the people you live with.
Part 2 · Describe a photograph
Talk for about one minute. Photo 1A: people learning a language. Photo 1B: people at a party. Talk about the people, the place and other things in the photo.
Please tell us what you can see in photograph 1A (people learning a language).
Please tell us what you can see in photograph 1B (people at a party).
Part 3 · Talk together

A young man works very hard and has only one free day a week. He wants to find an activity to help him relax. Talk together about the different activities he could do (see the picture sheet) and say which would be most relaxing.
Which of these activities would be the most relaxing for him? Why?
Which activity would you choose for yourself? Why?
Part 4 · Discussion
The examiner asks more questions about the topic of Part 3.
What do you do when you want to relax? Why?
Do you prefer to relax with friends or alone? Why?
Is it important to do exercise in your free time? Why/Why not?
Is it useful to learn new skills in your free time? Why/Why not?
Do you think people spend too much time working/studying these days? Why/Why not?
